prompt: UTG holds one pair with AsKd on Kh-8d-3c-2s, but BB pressure represents the stronger range after the turn. The hand is tempting, not secure. Choose the best action.
why_v1: Fold protects chips when one pair is too thin against the pressure range.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Folding fits because one pair does not beat the BB pressure range often enough to keep paying.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. One pair is not enough against the pressure range here, so continuing would overpay instead of taking the fold.
